Exercise: Elbows Back

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
isolation

Force Type:
static

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- shoulder_retraction
- internal_shoulder_rotation

Primary Muscles:

- chest

Secondary Muscles:

- shoulders

Equipment:
None

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
low to moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:
None

Contraindications:

- condition: shoulder instability, description: This exercise may exacerbate shoulder instability.
- condition: recent rotator cuff injury, description: Avoid this exercise until full recovery is achieved.

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Wall Angels, id: Wall_Angels

Instructions:

- Stand up straight.
- Place both hands on your lower back, fingers pointing downward and elbows out.
- Then gently pull your elbows back aiming to touch them together.
